#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_turret mp_carentan +set probe_teleport 1 +set probe_hitlog 1 +set probe_hitgrid 1
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --game-dir <UO install> --mod-dir uo --net-probe 127.0.0.1:32752 --probe-team axis --probe-fall --probe-secs 200
